applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Austrian social health insurance fund, disease management programmes

request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We evaluate whether our prevention programme reduced hospital admissions, to decide whether to extend it to all regions.
request.question: What is the mean BMI of women with breast cancer, by region?
definitions: Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Use the latest BMI (LOINC 39156-5) per patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per region: number of women with a BMI and mean BMI with one decimal.

note: allowed purpose, no reason why statistics are not enough: downgrade
